quote: After the wet dark days, the country seems more populous. It peoples itself in the sunbeams. The garden, mimic of spring, is gay with flowers.
source: Dorothy Wordsworth, The Alfoxden Journal, the opening entry, 20 January 1798 (ed. William Knight, Macmillan, 1897)
